killedBy: developer modules stay off ordinary paths (issue #946) no ordinary file under src/ imports a developer module for value
why: A planted negative control for the #946 ban on a real ordinary file: route-host.ts's type-only import of dev-diagnostics.ts loses its `type`, the edit an auto-import or a hurried merge makes. route-host.ts is the file a dedicated test held to no developer value edge before #1016 replaced it with the flat ban. The ban counts any import without a LEADING `type` as a value edge, so the sweep over the real tree fails naming route-host.ts. route-host.test.ts is in scope only so the mutation harness can reach the file, since dependency-direction.test.ts reads it through a raw glob the module graph does not relate; it passes under the mutation.
